**A map of the Moon you can turn and zoom like the Earth, links to Space & Moon reports, and a sweep for bugs.**

### ▶ [Open the live app](https://domw99.github.io/Gods-Eye-UAPs/)

**New**
- **The Moon map** (**☾ MOON MAP** in the top bar, <kbd>U</kbd>, the Moon tab of Space & Moon, or a link such as `#/moon/apollo-17`). A full-screen globe of the Moon, drawn on the Moon's own ellipsoid, that turns and zooms like the Earth one, from the whole Moon down to about a kilometre above the surface.
  - **NASA's pictures:** the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Camera mosaic at 100 metres to the pixel, from NASA Moon Trek. **RELIEF** lays the laser altimeter's colour-coded heights over it. A low-resolution copy ships with the app, so it still turns offline.
  - **89 named places** (seas, basins, craters, mountains and valleys, labelled as you zoom in) and **25 landing and impact sites**, from Luna 2 and the Surveyors through Apollo 11 to 17 and Chang'e 3 to 6 to Chandrayaan-3, SLIM and IM-1, each with its date and what it did.
  - **The lunar reports as numbered pins**, the same as in Space & Moon, including the far-side one the photograph couldn't show (Giordano Bruno, for Gervase of Canterbury in 1178). Click one to fly there and read the report, its explanation, its NASA files and its sources.
  - **Search** by name, English name ("Sea of Tranquility"), mission or year. Arrow keys turn the Moon, <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>−</kbd> zoom, <kbd>0</kbd> resets, <kbd>N</kbd> hides the names, <kbd>Esc</kbd> returns to the Earth. On a phone the list is a sheet that folds away.
  - The Earth stops drawing while it is open, and the Moon's video memory is released when you close it.
- **Links to Space & Moon.** `#/space`, `#/space/<tab>` and `#/space/<report>` open the dialog on that tab, scrolled to the report. **⧉ COPY LINK** on a card copies it.
- **A "what's new" note** for returning visitors, once, for this version (translated into all 15 languages).

**Faster to open on a slow connection**
- The installed app and the website now show the copy they saved after five seconds without an answer from the network, and save the late answer for next time.

**Fixed**
- **A link with a stray `%` in it** (a cut-off or hand-typed address such as `#/case/%`) stopped the app from starting. It now opens the app, and the part it can't read is left as it is.
- A damaged entry in the saved sighting log no longer discards the whole log.
